Sci-Fi Name Generator

Generate original sci-fi names — alien characters, human colonists, planets, and starships, one or ten at a time.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a style: alien, human, planet, or starship.
  2. Choose how many names to generate.
  3. Press Generate, then click any result to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Are these from Star Wars or Star Trek?

No — all names are assembled from original syllable banks, so nothing is copied from existing franchises.

What planet formats are supported?

Planets combine an original root (like Zephia or Corvos) with a Roman numeral or sector number, e.g. Zephia IV or Corvos-9.

How do I copy a result?

Click any generated name or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
